pr_summary: Extend the public API to support distance_metric (euclidean, cosine) for IVF-FLAT indexes. The fix adds INNER_PRODUCT and COSINE distance metric support to the IVF-FLAT index implementation, including vector normalization for cosine distance and proper handling of inner product results.

notes: This is a Python package with C++ extensions built using scikit-build-core and pybind11. The project is cross-platform (Linux, macOS, Windows) but CI primarily runs on Ubuntu. The fix.patch adds INNER_PRODUCT and COSINE distance metric support to IVF-FLAT indexes. The test.patch adds comprehensive tests for distance metrics including cosine distance validation against sklearn. The project requires TileDB as a core dependency and uses numpy < 2.0.0. Building from source requires cmake >= 3.22, pybind11, and TileDB library. For testing, pytest and scikit-learn are required.
